module: Node "AI Follow Waypoints" (color ai, once_f_duration). Makes a vehicle follow a list of navgraph waypoints with ai.driveUsingPath and detects the end of the laps. Inputs: navgraphPath (table, or aiPath inside it), vehId (no value = player), lapCount (hidden, 1), stopAtFinish (hidden, true: stops precisely at the last waypoint). Output: finalWp (hidden, name of the last waypoint). Legacy pin: waypointData became navgraphPath. Tags: ai, path, route, waypoint, race.
notes: In drawMiddle, finalWp.value is concatenated without tostring: a nil value would cause an error.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

onNodeReset.desc: Clears the path, resets the lap counters to zero, clears finalWp and goes to the "inactive" state.

getVeh.desc: Returns the vehicle whose id is given as input, or the player's vehicle (getPlayerVehicle(0)) without input.

workOnce.desc: Reads the path, computes lapCount, finalWp (last waypoint) and sends ai.driveUsingPath({wpTargetList, wpSpeeds, noOfLaps, aggression = 1}); in multi-lap mode, adds the first waypoint at the end; without stopAtFinish, sets the speed of the last waypoint to 100. Sets the state to "started".

work.desc: While "started", counts a lap when the vehicle passes within the radius of the last waypoint, re-arms when it is closer to the first one; goes to "finished" when lapsDone == lapCount.

drawMiddle.desc: Displays the state, the number of waypoints and the final target.
